steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Resistors: limit current flow - fixed (colour-coded), variable (potentiometers), thermistors (resistance changes with temperature - used in thermostats).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Capacitors: store and release electrical charge - timing circuits, smoothing power supplies. Electrolytic (high capacity, polarised) and ceramic (low capacity, non-polarised).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Transistors: electronic switches or amplifiers - small base current controls larger collector-emitter current. NPN and PNP types. Essential for logic circuits.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: LEDs: light-emitting diodes - convert electrical energy to light, very efficient, polarised. Need a current-limiting resistor. RGB LEDs combine three colours.
